articles.title: Critical GoAhead TLS Flaws Could Expose Hundreds of Millions of Devices to Attacks
articles.summary:

articles.title: Researchers Exploit OpenAI API Flaw to Extract Hidden GPT-5.6 Reasoning Traces
articles.summary:
Researchers at Xint found an OpenAI API flaw that exposed hidden reasoning in GPT-5.6 models by routing prompts through a conversation-compaction feature. The method, called compaction smuggling, bypassed protections introduced in August 2026.
